Asset type: photorealistic educational city-detail reconstruction.
Create ONE entirely new TEXT-ONLY image, native 1536 x 1024 landscape PNG, opaque RGB, sRGB. No input pictures or source-image pixels.

Scene: a quiet ordinary workday during 1820–1823 on Sikornik hill west of Kraków, while the memorial earth mound is still being built. The subject is the placement of small plain urns containing EARTH brought from battlefields into the unfinished mound. These are soil containers, never funeral ashes or human remains.
Composition: a broad camera view from a little below the worksite, looking upward toward the rough half-built earthen mound. The large uneven, unfinished mound and its loose brown soil are the main image. In the near middle ground, two small anonymous adult male volunteers, entirely seen from behind, kneel facing the slope and lower a simple lidded clay soil urn about 30 cm high into a shallow recess in the mound's side. A second plain unglazed clay urn is nearby with its lid resting beside it and ordinary dark soil visible inside. Their bodies and clothes naturally obscure all facial details. The people should be small, each at most about one fifth of image height, so the mound and worksite dominate. The deposition action must remain legible.
A few other small anonymous volunteers, both women and men, are farther away, also facing away from the camera, carrying soil urns or standing near simple wooden wheelbarrows. Period-plausible early-1820s practical linen/wool work clothing, long plain coats, trousers, simple caps, long skirts. No uniforms, emblems or elaborate costume. Wooden wheelbarrows with a single wooden wheel, rough timber handles, iron-bladed shovels resting with their blades lowered on the soil, footprints and coarse soil clods. No modern construction machines.
Backdrop: grassy rural hill, modest scattered trees and only a faint distant preindustrial Kraków silhouette in soft haze. No large modern city detail. The mound must be asymmetrical and incompletely shaped, without a finished summit monument, formal spiral footpath or later Austrian fortifications.
Style and lighting: convincing real camera photograph appearance, natural soft afternoon daylight, restrained exposure, muted earthy browns, gray-green grass and pale sky; realistic soil, dull clay, wool, timber and skin textures. A natural documentary photograph-like historical reconstruction, not a painting, drawing, illustration texture, sepia print, glossy render or dramatic cinematic poster. No HDR or oversaturated colors.
Avoid absolutely: ashes, bones, coffins, funerals, corpses, injuries, violence or blood; recognizable faces or the likeness of any named historical/real person including Kościuszko; large foreground people; any flags; Austrian fortress; today's smooth conical mound and long spiral path; modern buildings, cars, machines, signs, plaques, inscriptions, numerals, words, logos, watermarks or borders. No readable markings even on urns or tools.
